body: Ok, this failing check is a weird one I have no idea how the `partial` is failing. Couldn't reproduce it myself, but after looking at it I have no idea why I even used `partial` when I had access to a much easier solution

Here is the full list of options that gets ignored right now under some circumstances when set with `custom.py`.

`"debug_symbols"` always gets set to `"dev_build"` even the default value, unless `"production"` is true, then it is true.

Options that gets ignored with `"dev_mode"`:
- `"verbose"`
- `"warnings"`
- `"werror"`
- `"tests"`
- `"strict_checks"`

Options that gets ignored with "production":
- `"use_static_cpp"`
- `"debug_symbols"`
- `"swappy"` on android
- `"lto"`

Options that gets ignored on android:
- `"arch"`
- `"target"`

Options that gets ignored on ios:
- `"arch"`
- `"target"`
- `"use_volk"`
- `"metal"`
- `"builtin_pcre2_with_jit"`

Options that gets ignored on linuxbsd:
- `"arch"`

Options that gets ignored on macos:
- `"arch"`
- `"use_volk"`
- `"metal"`

Options that gets ignored on visionos:
- `"arch"`
- `"target"`
- `"use_volk"`
- `"metal"`
- `"builtin_pcre2_with_jit"`
- `"vulkan"`
- `"opengl3"`

Options that gets ignored on web:
- `"arch"`
- `"target"`
- `"builtin_pcre2_with_jit"`
- `"vulkan"`
- `"module_raycast_enabled"`
- `"optimize"`

Options that gets ignored on windows:
- `"arch"`
- `"d3d12"`

After looking at all of them maybe there should be a mechanism to disable some of them, but seeing as you can right now set them with command line arguments it shouldn't be involved in the parsing of values.

I see that this change is too large to originate from me and thanks to @adamscott 's [gist](https://gist.github.com/adamscott/82f2c51b73253712fdc7cadf72810899) I found a hacky workaround for linked issues that works for me.

Example `custom.py`:
```python
def set_args():
    from SCons.Script import ARGUMENTS
    def set_param(key, value):
        if key not in ARGUMENTS:
            ARGUMENTS[key] = value

    if ARGUMENTS.get("target", "editor") == "editor":
        set_param("production", True)
        set_param("lto", "none")
        set_param("debug_symbols", True)
        set_param("tests", True)
    
    if ARGUMENTS.get("target", "") == "template_release":
        set_param("production", True)
        set_param("optimize", "speed")

    if ARGUMENTS.get("target", "") == "template_debug":
        set_param("production", True)
        set_param("lto", "none")
        set_param("debug_symbols", True)

set_args()
```

Anyone can reference the current implementation or implement it again if they want it. Everything that I wrote about the issue is still correct at the time this comment was written.
